title: Teodoro warns China: Towing away BRP Sierra Madre would be 'act of war'
summary: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Friday said any attempt by China to tow away the BRP Sierra Madre in Ayungin Shoal would be considered an act of war.
